src/cnn.rs:
Missing weights are ignored

CNN::load only loads the safetensors file if it exists. Otherwise the network keeps its random initialisation and every call returns guesses without an error.
src/config.rs:
Load can write

Without config.json, Config::load writes the default into the model directory. In a read-only location (a mounted volume, an installed package) that fails with „Could not save config“. cuda and metal are accepted values but need candle features this crate does not enable.
src/lib.rs:
One public function

Only img_to_text is exported to Python; everything else here is the private image pipeline. Errors become ValueError; an image without detectable letters returns [""].
